title: Let agents commit on their own working branch before the gate and land by fast-forwarding master to that exact commit (Greg's option B)
outcome: Let agents commit on their own working branch before the gate and land by fast-forwarding master to that exact commit (Greg's option B)
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (byte-identical) allow an agent to commit its own change on its working branch or a detached HEAD in its own worktree, never on master and never pushed, so that reviews and the full gate run on a clean commit; and the standing approval lands such a change by fast-forwarding master to exactly the gated commit and pushing it. Everything else (rebase, force-push, history rewrite, commits on master, pushes of working branches) stays forbidden without Greg's own word.

/review-changes and the merger procedure describe the committed-input flow: freeze identity is the commit plus an empty gitignore-respecting status; if master has moved, the integration owner carries the change onto current master as a new commit that is gated as its own input; several READY packages are integrated as one integration commit on the integration owner's own worktree.

Landed under the authority-text process: (a) both coordinators' concurrence on the exact wording recorded on this item, (b) the exact wording and its consequence sent to Greg before landing, (c) the final-diff audit recorded as passed. Greg's widening word is recorded verbatim with its source (see notes).
The existing staged-tree lane stays valid until this lands, and in-flight inputs frozen under it are not re-cut because of this change.
